model.metricflow_probe.accounts.name: accounts
model.metricflow_probe.accounts.raw_code: select 1 as account_id, 100.0 as balance, date '2026-01-01' as snapshot_at

model.metricflow_probe.metricflow_time_s.name: metricflow_time_spine
model.metricflow_probe.metricflow_time_s.raw_code:
select cast(range as date) as date_day
from range(date '2026-01-01', date '2026-12-31', interval 1 day)

model.metricflow_probe.orders.name: orders
model.metricflow_probe.orders.raw_code:
select 1 as order_id, 1 as customer_id, 10.0 as amount, 'completed' as status,
       true as is_paid, date '2026-01-01' as ordered_at

model.metricflow_probe.payments.name: payments
model.metricflow_probe.payments.raw_code:
select 1 as payment_id, 10.0 as amount, 1.5 as fee, 'completed' as status,
       date '2026-01-01' as paid_at
